title: Claude orphaned outstanding work: explicit recovery of evidence eligibility, and the knowledge gap across a host restart
outcome: A session whose Claude work was left outstanding with no verified completion (a subagent or background command whose runtime was stopped or replaced, an abandoned call, or work past the per-session bound) has a truthful, explicit path back to evidence eligibility, and the host says what it no longer knows after a restart, instead of losing test credit in that workspace for good.
acceptance: Claude orphaned outstanding work: explicit recovery of evidence eligibility, and the knowledge gap across a host restart is done
